newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Ikon Office sags.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Ikon Office sags.

text.p: Ikon Office Solutions Inc shares dropped before Friday's market opening, hurt by warnings its earnings would be below analysts' estimates.
"Ikon seems to be dominating the news," a trader said. He and other traders said the market was otherwise quiet.
Ikon was trading at 25-1/2, down from Thursday's close of 32. The stock slid to 27-1/2 in after-hours trading.

The Valley Forge, Pa., office supplies company said after the market close Thursday it expected earnings per share in the third quarter to be between $0.30 and $0.32. A First Call consensus estimate for the quarter had been $0.40 per share.
The company also said it expected fourth-quarter earnings per share between $0.33 and $0.36. First Call's consensus estimate put Ikon's fourth-quarter earnings at $0.43 a share.
Ikon blamed the drop to short-term issues relating to its business transformation process.
Advanced Logic Research Inc rose to 15-1/2 from a closing price of 14-1/18 after Gateway 2000 Inc said it had agreed to buy the company for about $194 million or $15.50 per share.
Tobacco stocks were unmoved by expectations of an imminent settlement in talks between the industry and state attorneys general.
"All this stuff that they are talking about was already known yesterday," a trader said.
